findings.evidence: The 'Confirm cancellation' button is styled in red (a color typically associated with negative actions), while the 'Go back' button is white. findings.explanation: The red color of the 'Confirm cancellation' button is a deliberate design choice that creates a negative association with the cancellation action, while the white 'Go back' button appears more neutral. This misdirects the user's attention and may cause hesitation in completing the cancellation process, which is the user's stated goal.

legal.title: Résiliation en trois clics
legal.summary: Since 1 June 2023 (loi n° 2022-1158), a contract that can be concluded online must be cancellable online through a free, easily accessible feature.

legal.title: Simple mechanism to stop recurring charges
legal.summary: The Restore Online Shoppers' Confidence Act requires online negative-option sellers to provide simple mechanisms to stop recurring charges. (The FTC's 2024 click-to-cancel rule was vacated in July 2025; ROSCA still applies.)

legal.title: California Automatic Renewal Law
legal.summary: Consumers who sign up online must be able to cancel online, without obstruction.

legal.title: Ban on deceptive interface design by online platforms
legal.summary: Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 forbids online platforms from designing interfaces that deceive or manipulate users, including giving more prominence to certain choices, repeatedly requesting a choice already made, and making termination harder than subscribing.

legal.title: Unfair Commercial Practices Directive
legal.summary: Prohibits misleading and aggressive commercial practices, including non-contractual barriers to terminating a contract.
